newsitem.title: UK: Nat Express wins North London Rail franchise.
newsitem.headline: Nat Express wins North London Rail franchise.

text.p: Britain's Office of Passenger Rail Franchising (Opraf) said on Friday it had awarded the North London Railways Ltd franchise to rail and bus operator National Express Group Plc.

The franchise, which operates services on the Northampton Line, the North London Line and the West London Line, has been let for 7-1/2 years. National Express had been named as preferred bidder for the franchise.

Opraf said the company committed itself to expanding services and replacing all the slam door Mark 1 rolling stock with new or refurbished stock within two years. Investment in rolling stock, station facilities and security would exceed two million stg, Opraf said.

In return, National Express would receive subsidies at current prices of 48.6 million stg in the first year, declining to 16.9 million in the final year of the franchise for an average 26.98 million per annum, Opraf said.
Opraf said National Express would introduce a new service between Watford and Gatwick and add morning and evening services to and from London, Milton Keynes, Northampton and Birmingham.
